camel_example: aliyun fnf GetExecutionHistory --region cn-hangzhou --ExecutionName my_exec_name --FlowName my_flow_name
description_en: Queries the details about each step in an execution process
description_zh: 获取指定执行过程中的每个步骤详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun fnf get-execution-history --flow-name my_flow_name --execution-name my_exec_name --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetExecutionHistory

parameters.help_en: The name of the event to start the query. You can obtain the value from the response data
parameters.help_zh: Event查询开始名称，根据本接口返回获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of workflows that you want to query. Valid values: 1-999. Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh: 查询数量。取值范围[1,1000)，默认值为60
parameters.name: limit

EventDetail.description_en: The details about the execution step

EventId.description_en: The ID of the execution step

ScheduleEventId.description_en: The ID of the scheduling step

StepName.description_en: The name of the execution step

Time.description_en: The time when the event was updated
